In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou. |requirement = |startLocation = [[Startorch Academy (Region)|Startorch Academy]] |prev = We Choose the Sky |next = Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled |rewards =Union EXP*2,000;Astrite*200;Cloud Ride*1;Modding EXP*1600;Advanced Resonance Potion*7;Advanced Sealed Tube*7;Shell Credit*120,000 }} {{Intro/Quest}} ==Summary== {{color|old|Disclaimer: This is a compilation of Skip summary and may not reflect the accuracy of story.}} {{Description| On a peaceful day, you receive an express package from Huanglong containing a letter from Yangyang. Rover writes back to Yangyang. Somewhere along Jinzhou's border, Yangyang reads your letter as Chixia urges her onward. Together, they press toward their destination. At a deserted checkpoint, the Streams warn Yangyang of danger closing in on her and Chixia. As you prepare for your departure to Huanglong, Hiyuki, Mornye, and Luuk Herssen come to say goodbye. Hiyuki mentions a special farewell gathering Lucilla has prepared. Lucilla and everyone close to you hold a special graduation ceremony in your honor. With their warm wishes close to your heart, you set off on your new journey. Abby chatters on about Jinzhou's delicacies as usual. When no reply comes from Yangyang, you consider returning to Huanglong. With Abby's encouragement, you decide to head back to gather intelligence on the Court of Savantae and visit old friends. Jinzhou looks as familiar as ever, but a tense atmosphere grips the city. At Panhua's Restaurant, Zhezhi tells you that Yangyang entered the Land of Xuanfang and has since lost contact. Chixia, who accompanied her, was gravely injured in battle with Tacet Discords. Worried, you comfort Zhezhi and head straight to City Hall to ask Jinhsi for answers. At City Hall, Sanhua is greeting a special visitor: Suisui, the older sister Yangyang mentioned in her letter, who has come to Jinzhou looking for her. Jinhsi arrives and briefs you both on the crises in Jinzhou and Xuanfang Hold, entrusting you with a special frequency. Vowing to bring Yangyang and the missing citizens back safely, you accept the mission. Suisui decides to join you in your search for her sister. Before setting out, you visit Chixia at Huaxu Academy and are relieved to find her condition stable. Baizhi and Xiangli Yao brief you on Xuanfang Hold, with Xiangli Yao revealing that the Court of Savantae was involved in its construction. Suisui waits for you outside Huaxu Academy. She sees in your eyes the resolve you carry to find Yangyang and bring her back. You and Suisui arrive at Shaftpost Yard in the Southern Yuan Hills and find the area completely unguarded. To be safe, Suisui gives you a locator paired with her own. While searching for clues, Suisui spots a Rafter Kite carrying a letter in its beak. Just as she moves to share this with you, a dense fog rolls in and swallows Shaftpost Yard. Guided by the Rafter Kite, you manage to escape the fog but lose contact with Suisui. Nearby, you encounter Liangyu, a Xuanfang Warden. She explains that rogue Autopuppets and escaped Tacet Discords are now threatening the land, but that she had traveled with Yangyang days prior and the letter Suisui found was indeed written by Yangyang. To protect Chixia, Yangyang lures the Autopuppets and Tacets Discords deep into the Land of Xuanfang. Just as she is about to Overclock, a Rafter Kite leads a squad of Xuanfang Wardens to her rescue. Yangyang wakes up in an old house, overhearing Lianyu speaking with an elder outside. After exchanging information with Liangyu, Yangyang volunteers to help the Xuanfang Wardens evacuate the villagers to safety. An elder tells Yangyang the origins of the Rafter Kite and the legend of the Xuanling Bird. A Xuanfang Warden named Yanlang confides that Liangyu recently lost two comrades to Autopuppet ambushes. Out of concern, he asks Yangyang to keep an eye on Liangyu. A boy leads Yangyang to Xianling Village's shrine, where an old longsword is preserved. In a fleeting vision, she sees a fragment of memory, and later learns from the village chief that the sword once belonged to an unknown soldier from the Fortress and Gorges War. Out of respect for the fallen, the village chief asks Yangyang to deliver the sword to the Wardens for safekeeping. Yangyang presents the blade to Liangyu and relays the chief's wish. Overwhelmed by anxiety, Liangyu refuses to take it, so Yangyang decides to keep it for now. Seeing how disheartened Liangyu is by the loss of her comrades, Yangyang steps in to comfort her. Yangyang comforts Liangyu with a few gentle words and sings a song she heard from Liangyu earlier to ease the tense, suffocating atmosphere hanging over the village. When Xuanfang Warden Mingyu reports incoming Autopuppet movements, Yangyang volunteers to scout the Eastern Xuan Peaks to map a safe retreat route in place of their missing scouts. At the garrison camp, an Artisan begs Yangyang to use the Rafter Kite to send a letter home. She agrees, wishing him a safe return. As several cherished faces flash through her mind, Yangyang decides to pick up her pen and record her own journey, just in case. With Yangyang's help, the Wardens escort the villagers safely to camp. But just as they begin to relax, a sudden wave of Autopuppets and Tacet Discords ambushes them. Yangyang and two Xuanfang Wardens volunteer as bait to buy time for the evacuation. After a grueling battle, the villagers evacuate, but Mingyu and Yanlang are killed in action. As Yangyang mourns them, a melody drifts through the air. She turns, only to find herself on a battlefield. Walking through this Sonoro-formed battlefield, Yangyang hears a dying, blood-soaked Warden calling out to her in his final moments. The chaotic roar of ancient battle floods Yangyang's mind, splitting her head with pain. Amidst the agony, a faint, familiar song drifts from afar. On the battlefield, countless soldiers cry out to the Xuanling Bird, begging it to carry their final voices home. Witnessing their tragedy, Yangyang sings the familiar song in the bird's stead. Her voice stirs the Streams to guide the Reverberations of the fallen back to their homes. Meanwhile, a young Artisan from the Zhuojun Atelier arrives on the battlefield, deploying a squad of Bladepuppets. A voice pulls Yangyang out of the Sonoro Sphere. Before her stands Muyu, an Artisan from the Ministry of Development, who claims that clues to the Autopuppet rebellion lie in the Skyworks in the Western Fang Peaks. Sensing something amiss but needing answers, Yangyang decides to head into the Skyworks with him. Drawing upon the visions she witnessed on the ancient battlefield, Yangyang unmasks Muyu's true identity. Confronted, Muyu discards his disguise and confesses to orchestrating the chaos. Disgusted by his utter contempt for human life, Yangyang draws her blade and charges.}} ==Line Review== {{Tabber |Three Days Ago: Dawn| To uncover the truth behind the missing persons cases in Jinzhou, Yangyang and Chixia set out for the Land of Xuanfang.
